name: loader-line-fold
title: Loader Line Fold
description: A page preloader: the wordmark rises letter by letter while a hairline fills with a counter riding its tip. Once the page is ready the line travels to the middle, folds into a single point, and the page opens out of that point to every edge.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/block/loader-line-fold
GSAP plugins (CustomEase, SplitText) are registered inside the component, so there is nothing to set up.
Wrap the hero it should open onto, or pass `fullscreen` to cover the viewport on first load. The counter holds at 90% until fonts and every image inside have decoded.
